job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities.
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Director, Fan Engagement Marketing – International Club CRM & Performance Marketing
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking an experienced international marketing leader to play a key role in operating and scaling its International 1:1 Club Managed Services function.

This role leads day-to-day execution and operational delivery of a centralized, internal agency model that enables all 32 Clubs to execute compliant, high-quality, localized 1:1 fan engagement across more than 20 international markets.

The Director ensures Clubs receive reliable, scalable support across email, SMS, mobile app, web, and emerging channels by operationalizing league data, platforms, and best practices. Success is measured by execution quality, operational reliability, campaign performance, regulatory adherence, and Club satisfaction, while enabling sustained international fan development.

Responsibilities:

  • International Club Managed Services Execution
    • Support the Senior Director in operating the International 1:1 Club Managed Services model as an internal agency serving all 32 Clubs.
    • Execute against the defined service offering, engagement model, SLAs, intake processes, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across markets, time zones, and languages.
  • Global Operations & Workforce Enablement
    • Manage day-to-day operations of a distributed global workforce (including contingent associates across multiple regions).
    • Implement operating rhythms, workflows, training standards, and QA processes to support high-volume international execution.
    • Support capacity planning and workload balancing to meet Club demand while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • International 1:1 Marketing Delivery
    • Oversee execution of Club-led, league-enabled 1:1 campaigns across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web.
    • Ensure campaigns appropriately leverage behavioral, transactional, and engagement signals within market-specific constraints.
    • Apply testing frameworks and performance insights to drive continuous improvement at scale.
  • Data Privacy, Governance & Compliance Support
    • Execute established data governance and compliance standards for international fan data and PII usage.
    • Partner closely with Legal, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to ensure campaign execution aligns with GDPR and local market regulations.
    • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, executable guidelines for managed service teams and Clubs.
  • Club Enablement & Relationship Support
    • Act as a primary operational point of contact for Clubs on international 1:1 campaign execution and best practices.
    • Support Club adoption by delivering reliable service, clear communication, and timely issue resolution.
    • Escalate risks, constraints, and opportunities to the Senior Director with recommended solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting
    • Partner with International, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to align execution with league priorities.
    • Support quarterly planning cycles by translating demand forecasts into execution plans.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years' of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or performance-driven engagement, with international exposure

  • Demonstrated experience managing distributed teams or partners across regions and time zones
  • Strong executional fluency with MarTech platforms (CDPs, journey orchestration, messaging platforms)
  • Ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven workflows with consistency and accuracy
  • Background in sports, entertainment, or global consumer brands

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or scaling internal agency or managed services models in complex organizations
  • Strong operational instincts with the ability to translate strategy into repeatable execution
  • Comfortable working in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Data, and Technology teams in regulated markets
  • Global mindset with sensitivity to cultural and regional differences in fan engagement

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Execution-focused operator who takes pride in reliable delivery and operational excellence
  • Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to supporting Clubs as internal clients
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Clear, proactive communicator who escalates issues early and constructively
  • Comfortable operating under pressure in high-volume, time-sensitive environments
  • Influence-driven collaborator who builds trust without relying on formal authority
  • Curious, adaptable, and motivated to continuously improve processes, tools, and outcomes
  • Passion for sports – and the NFL in particular – with an appreciation for the role Clubs play in global fan growth

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets.
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

job.title: Manager, Hospitality (UK-External Agency Position)
job.description:
The Manager, Hospitality (UK) will play a key role in the planning, delivery, and execution of NFL Premium and VIP Hospitality programs for the NFL's international games and events. This individual will oversee guest experiences, ensuring best-in-class service for NFL partners, clients, and fans while helping deliver exceptional hospitality experiences that reflect the NFL brand.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the Hospitality Manager will lead and support hospitality initiatives before, during, and after international events throughout the year. The role requires strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused, with a passion for creating memorable experiences and a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver outstanding results.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and planning of all hospitality areas including suites, shared spaces, and NFL VIP for international games
  • Manage sales and event agencies to deliver a high-end hospitality program
  • Work collaboratively with participating teams in their hospitality delivery
  • Assist in the branding and design for all hospitality and customer facing areas
  • Conduit between contractors and NFL Creative
  • Day-to-day lead for stadium catering; assist in the creation of menus for GA/Hospitality areas
  • May include external events
  • Entertainment programming
  • Cross department guest list management alongside NFL Ticketing and Global Hospitality sales team
  • Working closely with the NFL’s Elite Service, management of internal clients, teams, NFL Executives and team ownership
  • Support in the execution of and delivery of the NFL international games
  • Lead or support in external partner events throughout the year

  • Minimum of 5 years’ working within sports and event industry
  • Working within stadiums is highly desired
  • Experience in managing and executing multiple events
  • Outstanding stakeholder management
  • Excellent time management, problem solving and organisational skills
  • Proficiency in MD Office (PPT, Word, Excell etc.) and excellent email management skill required
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Proactive mindset and professional manner to align with business objectives, customer expectations and brand values
  • Proficiency in English required, other languages encouraged
  • Awareness of cultural differences and inclusion
  • Willingness and availability to travel to local and international games (primarily Europe)

  • A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service and experiences

job.title: Manager, International Data and Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years in data strategy, product ownership, or technical leadership roles.
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale data initiatives, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with privacy and compliance standards, including GDPR/CCPA and consent data management, is preferred.
  • Knowledge of sports or fan-focused businesses, including an understanding of fan engagement and lifecycle marketing, is an advantage.
  • Proven experience working with AWS Redshift, Adobe Marketing Suite (AEP, AEM, AJO), BI Tools like Power BI, Tableau in a production environment is a plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of collaborating across cross-functional teams and influencing decisions in a matrixed organization without direct reporting authority.
  • Excellent communication skills with a demonstrated ability to engage senior leaders, work effectively with technical partners, and motivate teams to achieve high performance.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields

job.title: Part-Time Lead DAI Operator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Team is seeking an individual passionate about professional sports to lead the team responsible for Digital Ad Insertion for live football games. The Lead DAI Operator will be responsible for coordination and game day supervision of the team responsible for monitoring live game feeds from start to finish and inserting ad cues during commercial breaks. This is a hands-on lead position that will on occasion be responsible for performing DAI Operator responsibilities such as inserting ads into live games or other live video programing.

The role includes performing as a DAI Operator, inserting breaks and monitoring performance of ad delivery using a variety of visual and data reporting sources. The team’s focus is on continuous improvement in their ability to understand and measure the overall effectiveness of the ad delivery system, through evolving tools, processes and capabilities.

Responsibilities

As DAI Lead Operator:

  • Schedule DAI Operators for Live Game Coverage.
  • Distribute Game Format Sheets and other assignment information.
  • Address any Operator-specific equipment, logistics or access issues.
  • Supervise all aspects of ad delivery performance, including accuracy, analytics generation and performance metric reporting.
  • Lead Operator conference calls.
  • Supervise break assignments, schedule changes and other real-time events during game windows.
  • Communicate any issues to appropriate parties.
  • Direct and perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.

As DAI Operator:

  • Monitor Live Game Video for commercial breaks and compare broadcast feed to digital distribution.
  • Perform as a either a primary operator or as a backup.
  • Monitor listen-only lines for commercial break instructions.
  • Follow Ad Break program guides and calculate break durations and break insertion points.
  • Report any issues to appropriate NFL management via established procedures.
  • As directed, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.
  • Perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.
  • In a lead capacity, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.

Required Qualifications

  • Must have high school diploma; GED or equivalency (Some college, no degree required)
  • Proven experience working with computers in an office environment.
  • Experience working in a Lead role and/or supervisory capacity.
  • Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Applications (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook) in PC or MAC.
  • Working knowledge of email, slack and web browsers in PC or MAC
  • Strong communication and analysis skills
  • Must be extremely organized and detail-oriented with the ability to follow through on multi-step instructions.
  • General availability for Sunday and other peak event Game Days during the NFL Football season – refer to nfl.com/schedule for specific dates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors, or Associate degree preferred
  • Prior experience working for the NFL.
  • Previous experience working in live TV/broadcast environments (production, stage, etc.) is preferred.
  • Management experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Ad insertion
  • Availability on non-Game Days a consideration.
  • Availability for occasional in-office work is a consideration.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must possess a strong work ethic, positive workplace approach and work well with others.
  • Passionate sports-fan, knowledgeable about football (preferred not required).
  • Punctuality is must in this position.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • This is a remote position
  • Up to 7 months of employment based on business needs
  • Part-time - Must be available for 4 hour (min) to 8 hour (max) shifts on NFL Gamedays (Monday, Thursday, Sunday) and holidays where schedule applies (Thanksgiving, etc.)
  • Occasional overtime as needed and approved.

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking an experienced Audio 1 (A1) to lead audio production for live and recorded programming across NFL Media platforms. This position serves as the primary audio lead responsible for the planning, execution, mixing, and overall quality of audio elements supporting studio, remote, and special event productions.

The ideal candidate possesses extensive live broadcast audio experience, strong technical expertise in modern IP-based audio environments, and a proven ability to perform in fast-paced, high-profile sports production settings. Production services will be based at NFL Media's state-of-the-art broadcast facility in Inglewood, California.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead audio mixer for live and recorded productions, ensuring the highest level of audio quality and operational excellence.
  • Design, configure, and execute complex audio workflows for studio shows, remote broadcasts, special events, and digital productions.
  • Operate and mix live productions utilizing broadcast audio consoles, playback systems, communication systems, and IP-based audio infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, technical directors, engineering teams, and production personnel to deliver consistent and impactful audio experiences.
  • Develop and maintain show-specific audio configurations, routing strategies, and operational workflows.
  • Lead audio planning for remote productions, transmission paths, venue integration, and signal management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical audio issues in real time while maintaining on-air continuity.
  • Oversee proper setup, operation, and optimization of communications systems, including Riedel intercom platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with broadcast audio standards and best practices across stereo, surround sound, and emerging audio formats.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and operational direction to A2 and A3 personnel and freelance audio staff as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in emerging broadcast technologies, IP networking standards, and audio production workflows.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional broadcast audio experience, including significant experience mixing live sports and studio productions.
  • Proven experience serving as an Audio 1 (A1) or senior-level broadcast audio mixer in a professional television, streaming, or live event environment.
  • Advanced experience operating SSL audio consoles; experience with SSL System T and S500 platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in stereo, 5.1 surround, and multi-channel broadcast audio mixing.
  • Extensive knowledge of IP-based audio infrastructures, including AES67, Dante, SMPTE 2110, and related broadcast networking technologies.
  • Experience supporting complex remote productions, transmission workflows, and large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, routing, communications systems, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Proficiency with playback systems, audio servers, and broadcast production technologies.
  • Experience working with Riedel communications systems and networked intercom environments preferred.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting national sports broadcasts and large-scale live events.
  • Dante Certification or equivalent IP audio networking credentials.
  • Experience with EVS audio workflows and replay systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based or remote production environments.
  • CTS, Dante, or other relevant industry certifications.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met. Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast. Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects. Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +. The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths.
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities.

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity.

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency
  • Ability to remain calm and make precise technical adjustments under pressure in live broadcast environments
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across control room, engineering, and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple camera feeds and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot complex video and signal issues in real time
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently or within a team environment

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs as required for production setup and support

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Schedule driven by production needs, including live broadcasts and events
  • Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays
  • This is a part-time position based on operational requirements up to 29 hours per week

job.title: Seasonal Production Coordinator II
job.description:
The Production Coordinator II oversees the full logistics of assigned on‑location shoots for NFL Films Productions. This role manages crew movements, equipment rentals, travel, permitting, and vendor communication from preproduction through wrap. The coordinator ensures all operational details are executed accurately and efficiently, serving as a key liaison between internal departments to keep shoots running smoothly and on schedule.

This is a 7-month seasonal position. Candidates are required to work 5 days week from our offices in Mt. Laurel, NJ.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee all logistics of on location shoots as assigned, from start to finish, specifically crew movements, equipment shipments, and vendor communication
  • Hire camera, audio & support crew for on location filming & ensure the onboarding process is complete prior to filming
  • Coordinate all crew travel, including booking flights, hotels & rental vehicles
  • Research & book local equipment rentals not provided by the NFL Films Camera & Audio departments
  • Research & book locations, oversee permitting & handle all administrative tasks associated with those responsibilities including securing vendor paperwork, releases & processing payment
  • Handle all shoot communication including updating the online shoot schedule, sending shoot emails & creating call sheets
  • Work closely with other departments to ensure budget considerations & crew assignments are communicated quickly & efficiently
  • Administrative tasks may include answering phones, requesting certificates of insurance, reviewing invoices & updating department tracking documents to ensure consistency & accuracy

Required Qualifications

  • Candidate should have 2–3+ years of experience coordinating on‑location shoots in film, television, or live event production, with demonstrated ability to independently manage logistics, travel, vendors, and shoot communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong working knowledge of TV/film production, including camera, audio, lighting, and grip equipment, as well as a clear understanding of crew roles, responsibilities, and on‑set workflows.
  • Familiarity with NFL and NFL Films programming, past and present, with the ability to support shoots that require historical context, archival awareness, or football specific operational needs.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess strong organizational and time management skills and high-level attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent communication skills

Physical Demands

  • Position involves coordinating productions on location

Travel

  • Shoot &/or event needs may require the coordinator to travel on location up to 30% of the time

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week. Production demands may include additional hours, nights, and weekends.

The NFL is seeking a Seasonal Vertical Video editor and programmer to work with the Digital Video team on producing content for the NFL's YouTube and social channels, focusing on the ideation, curation, and execution of vertical video. The Digital Video team is responsible for distributing and programming content across the NFL’s digital ecosystem, reaching millions of NFL fans each day. The Vertical Video editor will play a key role in producing short form content for NFL Media digital platforms, as well as engaging fans on YouTube and social by programming engaging content for NFL’s broad fanbase leveraging content from games, NFL podcasts, NFL studio shows, NFL archive, and premiere NFL events such as Playoffs and Super Bowl.

job.title: Senior Director, Creative
job.description:
The Senior Creative Director, NFL Brand Experience, shares in the leadership of the NFL’s in-house creative agency. The Brand Experience team is responsible for setting the creative foundation and story for nearly every expression of the National Football League’s brand. From global events like Super Bowl, Draft and a growing slate of International Games around the world, to the brands, identities and uniform designs of the 32 Clubs, to every cause or initiative, to apparel and fashion and beyond, the Brand Experience team is there, where the brand meets our fans. The Senior Creative Director is a mentor and culture-carrier, who is as passionate about how we work, as they are with the creative excellence of the work we produce.

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to the department head - VP, Head of Global Brand Experience in fostering a creative, supportive and inspiring team culture.
  • Leadership of multiple design teams overseeing the branding and creative strategy for global NFL events.
    • Mentorship and career development of creative talent and the future leadership of the team.
  • Representing the Brand Experience team with NFL Club ownership, internal executives, media, and host cities and communities around the world. A steward of the team, our reputation, and our ability to shine light on the cultures and stories wherever football takes us.
  • Work in collaboration with the Director of Project Management to oversee all team operations including the evaluation and refinement of the team’s workflow and creative processes
    • Managing the creative development and delivery calendar
    • Support the oversight of the department budget and budget planning
  • Oversee the documentation and promotion of the team’s output, including:
    • Managing the capture of our behind the scenes, process and artist collaborative content
    • Managing the yearly submission of work for industry recognition and promotion cross-organizationally

  • 10-15+ years of creative leadership experience
  • Insatiable curiosity and a truly unique creative point of view
    • Deep knowledge of NFL football is helpful, but not a requirement. Creative drive, fresh thinking, and extraordinary human-first leadership skills are essential. X’s and O’s are teachable.
  • Proven experience, excellence and innovation in the following areas of design and studio or agency leadership (but not limited to):
    • Large scale event and experiential design
    • Identity design and typography
    • Brand building, brief writing - an overall high level of communication savvy
    • Design for retail, fashion and consumer products
    • Video and motion design
    • Budget, workflow and timeline management

  • At least 7+ years of team leadership experience

job.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts (France)
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts will be responsible for successfully managing all partners who have sponsorship rights in France to meet annual revenue targets.

The role will require someone who possesses strong leadership skills with experience of working cross functionally and championing partner programs internally. Results will be measured against team performance, sponsorship revenue, activation, and satisfaction, along with increased and improved fan engagement metrics.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Exceptional Partnership Management:

  • Develop relationships with existing NFL partners and be adept at resolving partner issues, thinking creatively and efficiently to reach solutions.
  • Identify and contact key decision makers at C-suite level.
  • Lead on local renewals process for Partners and support the team on upsells to meet revenue targets, collaborating closely with the global team to capitalize on available activation funds.

Support Revenue Growth through New Business

  • Support Global New Business by providing market perspectives, identifying relevant local targets / contacts, and recommending / prioritizing white space opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with NFL Marketing and Consumer Products teams to develop integrated partnership solutions that align sponsor objectives with NFL fan growth and engagement priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and revenue streams including exploitation of traditional inventory and digital opportunities
  • Analyze opportunities for growth in new areas to drive profitability and conduct regular analysis to mitigate any potential risks.
  • Provide support using key sponsorship and valuation metrics during contractual discussions.
  • Build innovative and tailored propositions that attract and convince potential sponsors to partner with the NFL.
  • Manage local sales agencies ensuring they execute their scope of work and provide support as needed.
  • Adopt a proactive approach to secure incremental revenue, working closely with the international team as well as Marketing and Consumer Products department.

Flawless In-Market Activation Execution

  • Work with the Global Sponsorship Team, to ensure a consistent look and feel is achieved and a joined-up approach, where relevant is adopted.

job.title: Senior Manager, Event Operations, UK (External Agency Position)
job.description:
The NFL Event Operations team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Manager of Event Operations to lead the planning, overlay and delivery of NFL International Games across the UK and Europe.

Reporting to the Director of Event Operations, this role will provide senior operational leadership from initial planning and stadium overlay through to Gameday delivery and post-event assessment. The role will lead an event operations team and work closely with stadium and city partners, NFL clubs, vendors and a broad range of stakeholders to deliver world-class NFL games in Europe. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of complex live-event environments, exceptional project management skills and the ability to lead confidently in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. The role will be primarily based at the NFL UK offices in London, with relocation to host stadiums during game weeks. Frequent international travel, as well as evening and weekend work will be required.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, with responsibility for high-profile International Games in Europe and opportunities to contribute to the wider portfolio of NFL League events.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive operational overlay plans for NFL International Games at host stadiums.
  • Lead stadium transformation, construction and conversion planning, ensuring all requirements are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required NFL standard.

  • Manage the stadium operations budget, including forecasting, cost control, purchase orders and payments.
  • Provide clear operational leadership and decision-making throughout game week, proactively identifying and resolving issues and escalating critical matters where appropriate.
  • Support the planning and delivery of sponsor and partner activations within the wider event environment.
  • Ensure appropriate health, safety and operational compliance standards are maintained throughout planning, build and event delivery.
  • Work closely with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement contingency and risk-management plans.
  • Lead post-event debriefs, assessments and reporting, identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of operational best practices, processes and standards for future International Games and wider NFL events.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge and proven experience planning and delivering complex, large-scale live events.
  • Educated to degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years' experience working within a stadium, venue, live events or comparable operational environment.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational delivery team.

job.description:
The Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship & New Business Development is a key member of the NFL's Global Sponsorship Business Development team, responsible for driving revenue through the development and sale of integrated global marketing partnerships.

Working across the NFL's international business, this role will identify, develop, and secure strategic partnerships that support the league's key growth priorities, including NFL FLAG, international expansion, game innovation, and audience growth among youth, multicultural, and women’s audiences. The successful candidate will play a critical role in identifying new business opportunities, cultivating senior-level relationships, and delivering innovative partnership solutions that create value for both the NFL and its partners.

This position is with a third-party agency that provides services to the NFL. The selected candidate will be employed by the agency, not the NFL, and will be based at the NFL’s office in London, UK. The agency will be responsible for all compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment. The assignment supporting the NFL will be for a defined period and may be extended by mutual agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective global and regional partners to achieve sponsorship revenue targets.

job.title: VP, Product & Design
job.description:
The VP (Vice President), Product & Design will lead product experience and roadmap development across the NFL’s portfolio of digital products and platforms, translating vision and strategy into scalable execution. As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

Product Vision & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own the product roadmap for the NFL’s fan-facing product portfolio across web, app, CTV, identity, and subscription experiences
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate enterprise priorities and agreed business objectives into product roadmap decisions, prioritization, sequencing, and execution plans
  • Lead short-term, seasonal, and multi-year product roadmap planning and sequencing, aligned to the broader long-range business plan and agreed investment priorities
  • Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

Product Delivery & Performance

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for product roadmap execution, sequencing, delivery excellence, experience quality, product operating cadence, and post-launch value optimization across the digital portfolio
  • Translate agreed strategic priorities into delivered product outcomes that support business goals
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to define KPI frameworks, measurement processes, and post-launch evaluation methodologies
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation, learning, and iteration

Fan Experience & Design Leadership

  • Lead the Product and Design organizations responsible for creating engaging and intuitive fan experiences
  • Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys
  • Ensure consistency and quality across all fan-facing experiences

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Technology to align product roadmaps with technical feasibility, platform architecture, capacity management, and release planning
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate agreed business objectives, priority fan segments, value propositions, and desired outcomes into product experiences
  • Partner with Content and Marketing to ensure product experiences, content value, and marketing execution reinforce the broader strategy
  • Build strong executive partnerships that improve decision making and organizational coordination
  • Communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Product and Design organization
  • Build team capabilities through coaching, succession planning, and talent development
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and product excellence

  • 15+ years of product management experience, including leadership roles in digital media, streaming, sports, technology, or subscription-based businesses

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams within highly matrixed environments
  • Strong understanding of digital consumer experiences, content ecosystems, subscription products, and engagement platforms
  • Experience leading Product, UX/UI, Design, or adjacent digital experience functions

Leadership Profile:

  • Proven track record collaboratively shaping and delivering product roadmaps that drive business outcomes across large-scale consumer digital platforms
  • Demonstrated success delivering product roadmaps that support acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization objectives within DTC or subscription-led businesses

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KBZK
job.description: At KBZK, storytelling is more than a job. It's a chance to capture the people, places, and moments that make western Montana unlike anywhere else in the country. We're looking for a Multimedia Journalist who wants to immerse themselves in the community, chase meaningful stories, and bring them to life across multiple platforms. From breaking news and in-depth features to live reporting from the field, you'll be at the center of the stories that matter most to our viewers. If you're energized by journalism, inspired by mountain landscapes, and excited about making a real impact in a close-knit community, we'd love to meet you. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Develop story ideas by researching news leads, tips, and emerging community issues. Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, and in-depth research. Write compelling, accurate stories that meet broadcast and digital editorial standards. Shoot engaging video and capture still photography to support storytelling across platforms. Edit video content for on-air broadcasts, digital channels, and social media. Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news, community events, and enterprise stories. Appear on-air for interviews, stand-ups, and story narration. Collaborate closely with photographers, producers, and digital teams to create impactful coverage. Assist in preparing daily newscasts and multimedia content plans. Consistently produce content that informs, connects, and serves the communities of western Montana. WHAT YOU'LL NEED: Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Three or more years of experience in television news, multimedia journalism, or a related field preferred. Valid driver's license, good driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements. Ability and willingness to travel throughout the viewing area to cover stories and community events. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Strong broadcast writing skills and knowledge of AP Style. Experience with videography and non-linear editing systems. Working knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment. Experience editing on Final Cut Pro or similar editing platforms. Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and digital publishing tools. Ability to post and optimize content for websites and digital platforms. A self-starter mindset with excellent time management and organizational skills. Sound news judgment and the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines. A collaborative approach and passion for community-focused storytelling. Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds of equipment when needed. OUR TEAM: At KPAX, you'll join a passionate group of journalists, photographers, producers, and storytellers who care deeply about serving their community. We believe great journalism starts with curiosity, authenticity, and teamwork. Our newsroom values diverse perspectives, fresh ideas, and a relentless commitment to telling stories that matter. You'll have the support to grow your craft while working alongside talented teammates who love what they do and where they live. WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountains, Bozeman offers an unmatched blend of outdoor adventure, vibrant culture, and small-town charm. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and just a short drive from Yellowstone National Park, you'll find year-round opportunities for hiking, skiing, mountain biking, fishing, and exploring some of the country's most breathtaking landscapes. Bozeman's energetic downtown features locally owned restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, live music venues, and a thriving arts scene that gives the city a unique personality. Bozeman is also home to Montana State University, helping create a dynamic and innovative community that attracts entrepreneurs, outdoor enthusiasts, and creative professionals from around the country. With excellent schools, a strong sense of community, and easy access to world-class recreation, it's a place where professional growth and quality of life go hand in hand. job.description: The Manager, Multimedia Content, Live Video Streaming & Programming will lead TelevisaUnivision Local Media's live video strategy and programming across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms. This role will lead a team responsible for live production, digital video, and social content, while overseeing programming strategy, content execution, audience growth, and monetization. Identify opportunities to increase revenue and monetization through programming, audience growth, partnerships, and platform capabilities. Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify compelling, culturally relevant content for Latino audiences. job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We're investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. We continue to expand our global footprint through our flagship streaming platform, ViX. The Senior Software Engineer, Backend will join our Core Digital Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and evolving the backend services that power products used by millions of users across the U.S., Mexico, Spain, and Latin America. The Senior Software Engineer will design and develop highly scalable distributed systems, resilient microservices, and cloud-native applications that support one of the largest Spanish-language streaming platforms in the world. Working closely with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), QA, Security, and fellow engineering teams, this role will help deliver reliable, high-performance backend systems while contributing to the evolution of our engineering standards and platform architecture. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, building software at internet scale, and continuously improving platform performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. ABOUT YOU: You are passionate about building software the right way. You believe maintainable code, scalable architectures, automation, and engineering excellence are essential to delivering world-class digital products. You enjoy diving deep into technical challenges, understanding systems end-to-end, and designing backend services that remain reliable as traffic, complexity, and business demands continue to grow. You naturally raise the engineering bar through thoughtful technical design, high-quality code reviews, mentorship, and continuous learning. You thrive in collaborative environments where ownership, innovation, and engineering excellence are highly valued. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (Responsibilities) Design, build, and maintain highly scalable backend services and microservices supporting TelevisaUnivision's digital products. Develop secure, resilient, and high-performance RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services consumed by millions of users. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code using modern software engineering practices, including unit, integration, and performance testing. Design distributed systems capable of supporting high traffic, low latency, and high availability. Optimize application performance across services, databases, caching layers, messaging systems, and cloud infrastructure. Participate in architecture reviews and influence technical decisions for new products, platform enhancements, and modernization initiatives. Take ownership of backend services throughout their lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement. Serve as a technical leader on complex engineering initiatives by helping guide architectural decisions, establishing engineering best practices, and influencing technical direction across the team. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, DevOps, QA, Security, and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Perform thoughtful code reviews while mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices across the organization. Improve platform observability through centralized logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, and performance metrics. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and continuous delivery initiatives that improve software quality and release velocity. Drive technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and adoption of modern backend engineering practices. Participate in production support, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements. Influence engineering decisions through data-driven problem solving, technical expertise, and collaborative partnership across teams. YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience) 6+ years of professional experience building backend applications in production environments. Strong experience designing distributed systems and scalable service-oriented architectures. Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language such as Go, Java, Python, C#, or a comparable language. Extensive experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services. Strong understanding of software architecture principles, including SOLID, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and common design patterns. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with caching technologies such as Redis or Memcached. Experience with asynchronous messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub, or similar technologies. Experience deploying and operating services within cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS. Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native application development. Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. Familiarity with observability tools including centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, and distributed tracing. Strong understanding of backend security best practices, including authentication, authorization, API security, and secrets management. Experience working within Agile software development environments. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from design through production while balancing scalability, reliability, and maintainability. job.title: IT Network Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our IT Network Manager, you will lead a dedicated team of network and voice engineers while bridging the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge broadcast technology. We are looking for a people-first, Cisco-certified leader to guide, mentor, and empower an engineering team overseeing the lifecycle of our network infrastructure. Beyond technical mastery, you will cultivate a high-performing team culture centered on collaboration, continuous growth, high availability, and proactive security. If you thrive in inspiring technical talent within an 'always-on' environment and have a passion for seamless media delivery, this is your next challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of network and voice engineers; establish clear goals, manage team performance, drive professional development, and champion a collaborative, supportive engineering culture.
  • Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure Management: Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network, wireless, and Storage Area Networking (SAN) infrastructure across Cisco ACI, Catalyst/Nexus, Firepower (FTD), SD-WAN, and Meraki platforms.
  • Broadcast Network Alignment: Partner with broadcast engineering teams to guide your team in maintaining a high-availability IP broadcast network that carries low-latency, real-time audio and video traffic for NPR’s daily content production and live transmission.
  • Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership: Lead network operations, incident management, and root-cause analysis for complex issues; coach team members through high-pressure troubleshooting using monitoring tools like SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, and ThousandEyes.
  • Documentation & Standards: Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, standard operating procedures, and routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP), ensuring network reliability, scalability, security, and team operational best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with Security, DevOps, Systems, and Enterprise Application teams, while effectively communicating network performance, risk analyses, incident reports, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking.
  • 3+ years directly managing and developing technical teams in a network leadership or manager role.
  • Proven track record of talent development, performance management, team building, and leading engineering teams through major operational projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco Nexus (NX-OS)
    • Cisco Firepower (FTD)
    • Cisco Routing and Switching
    • Cisco ACI
    • Cisco SD-WAN
    • Cisco Meraki
    • Enterprise Wireless Networks
  • Strong expertise in routing and switching (BGP, EIGRP).
  • Experience with at least one of the following network management and observability platforms: SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Intersight, or similar enterprise network monitoring and management tools .
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, team leadership, and documentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through critical production outages and high-pressure incident response, ensuring fast service recovery, effective team coordination, and business continuity.
  • Ability to translate complex broadcast requirements into scalable network architectures, overseeing robust business continuity planning, and fostering a team culture of technical excellence and psychological safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Data Center).
  • lCisco CCIE certification.
  • Experience with ThousandEyes.
  • Experience with high-quality, real-time audio and video over IP networks, such as SMPTE ST 2110 and NDI, particularly in a IP broadcast environment.
  • Working knowledge of PTP, SMPTE ST 2110, multicast, and QoS.
  • Experience with large-scale or multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Experience with network automation / Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with managing on-prem and hosted Telephony and AV systems.
  • Experience supporting audio/video transmission or production workflows.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location as assigned. On-site assignments are determined by a monthly rotation schedule. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia Metro Area.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $158,500 - $180,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.
