job.title: Associate Director, Audience Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director of Audience Development to join our New York-based Marketing Strategy & Audience Development team. This role will lead the day-to-day strategy and hands-on execution of first-party fan data acquisition campaigns (email & SMS), with a particular focus on building high-intent email and SMS audiences that can be converted into e-commerce merchandise buyers & beyond.

Reporting to the Vice President, Audience Development, this role combines strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution and data-driven performance optimization. You’ll leverage proprietary technology, paid and organic marketing channels, live events and third-party audience tools to deliver measurable growth for artists and label partners across multiple genres and career stages.

Please note: This is a hands-on role that will occasionally require evening or weekend work to support priority releases & live events.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

First-Party Data Acquisition Strategy

  • Partnering closely with our Marketing Strategists, you’ll lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS.
  • Use data to identify the right value exchange for each audience, including exclusive content, early merchandise access, contests, ticket presales, live-event activations and other fan experiences.
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to ensure newly acquired fans enter CRM lifecycle journeys and receive a cohesive experience from initial sign-up through conversion and retention.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Support our Marketing Strategists by owning the end-to-end execution of fan acquisition campaigns, including campaign planning, audience strategy, platform setup, landing pages, sign-up flows, testing, launch and performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy & Global Paid Media teams to develop and optimize impactful paid lead-generation campaigns across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish testing frameworks and best practices across landing pages, forms, incentives, messaging and acquisition channels to improve both the volume and quality of acquired fans.

E-Commerce & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with D2C, CRM and Marketing Strategy teams to connect your acquisition campaigns to downstream product discovery, sales conversion and repeat-purchase opportunities.
  • Use transactional and behavioral data to identify the channels, campaigns and fan segments most likely to generate merchandise revenue.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to build clear handoff strategies that move newly acquired fans into personalized welcome, nurture and conversion journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM and Global Paid Media to evaluate acquisition performance beyond initial sign-up volume, using metrics such as cost per acquired fan, subscriber quality, engagement, first-purchase conversion, revenue per acquired fan and return on investment.

Audience Insights, Measurement & Reporting

  • Develop reporting frameworks that connect fan acquisition activity to downstream engagement, streaming, ticketing and e-commerce outcomes.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Analyze fan behavior to identify high-value audience segments, acquisition sources and conversion patterns.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for internal teams, artists and label partners.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.

Tools, Technology & Innovation

  • Oversee the strategic use of proprietary and third-party audience acquisition tools, landing-page platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fan sign-up experiences, progressive data collection, audience segmentation, consent management and data enrichment.
  • Partner with Product, Design & Engineering teams to help guide the development of tools and features that improve first-party data acquisition and measurement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Relationship Management, Fan Engagement & CRM, Privacy and Product, Design & Engineering teams to ensure acquisition campaigns comply with global privacy and consent requirements.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in evaluating and testing new fan acquisition technologies, platforms and partners.
  • Monitor emerging audience-development trends within music and across industries such as gaming, sports, television, film and retail.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Education

  • Partner with Relationship Management, Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy, Brand Marketing, Fan Engagement & CRM, D2C e-commerce and Marketing Strategy teams to integrate first-party data acquisition into artist campaigns.
  • Serve as an audience-development thought leader internally and as a trusted advisor to artist and label partners, providing best-practice guidance and data-driven recommendations.
  • Educate internal teams and clients on the role first-party fan data can play in driving long-term audience ownership and commercial growth.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in educating marketers across global markets on acquisition strategies appropriate to their local audiences, platforms, cultures and privacy requirements.
  • Help establish repeatable processes that make audience acquisition a consistent component of priority artist and release campaigns.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience within music, entertainment or another consumer-focused industry, including e-commerce experience.
  • Proven track record of growing first-party email and SMS audiences and connecting that growth to measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing lead-generation campaigns across paid, organic, artist-owned and partner channels.
  • Experience with audience and marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Laylo, Salesforce, Braze or similar tools, as well as e-commerce platforms like Shopify.
  • Understanding of conversion funnels, landing-page optimization, audience targeting, A/B testing and customer acquisition economics.
  • Deep understanding of first-party data strategy, including value exchange, audience segmentation, consent management and data privacy best practices such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using dashboards and KPI reporting to evaluate acquisition quality and downstream conversion.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator who can advise multiple stakeholders and translate complex audience strategies into clear, actionable plans.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic planning with detailed, hands-on campaign execution.
  • Passionate about music, fan behavior, e-commerce and the use of technology to build lasting artist-fan relationships.
  • Intrinsically motivated to find new and exciting ways to identify and acquire music fans, with a curious mindset and a strong desire to test, learn and scale successful approaches.
  • Comfortable working flexible hours when needed to support our partners, live events and high-priority releases.

As a CRM Manager, you will work closely with SME UK labels to deliver best-in-class, creative and data-led fan engagement campaigns - driving growth of existing fanbases and acquisition of new audiences. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Digital Media, Web Ops, and eCommerce teams to create seamless, high-impact fan experiences across channels – focussing on first party audience growth and commercial opportunities

You will also work closely with our Global Product, Design and Engineering team who are responsible for providing the tech by which you will deploy campaigns. With this you will actively demonstrate best-in-class campaigns from the UK and provide continual feedback to this group to develop our offering in this space and contribute to the global strategy.

What you'll do:

  • Design and execute data-led fan engagement strategies that drive first‑party data acquisition, deepen audience understanding, and build long-term fan value.
  • Apply advanced CRM and segmentation strategies (lifecycle marketing, behavioural targeting, propensity modelling) to personalise journeys and optimise D2C conversion and monetisation.
  • Develop best-in-class, insight-driven campaigns for Artists combining creativity with performance data to maximise engagement and revenue impact.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design & Engineering and Legal teams to scale first‑party data automation, ensuring compliant data capture and seamless flow across platforms.
  • Leverage partner tools and emerging technologies to continuously test, learn, and optimise campaigns- driving fan growth, innovation and commercial outcomes.
  • Champion a first‑party data mindset - embedding segmentation, personalisation, and cross-channel adaptation across organic fan engagement, paid media, and D2C touchpoints (with Ceremony of Roses)
  • Define KPIs, deliver actionable reporting, and lead the technical execution of fan data infrastructure - Leveraging SQL within our data warehousing (Snowflake) and tracking frameworks (UTMs, event tagging) to structure, enrich, and analyse fan data, translating performance and behavioural insights into clear optimisation actions

Who you are:

  • Proven experience delivering data driven fan campaigns, preferably in Music, Entertainment or Media.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, Excel, GA4 or similar technologies
  • Experience with fan journeys, segmentation, and first party data visualisation
  • Knowledge in HMTL, CSS and D2C data e.g Shopify
  • Knowledge of Data Protection legislation and data management
  • Use of third-party tools (or similar) such as Wyng, Asana and Appreciation Engine
  • Strong project management skills, detail-orientated, excellent communicator, and enthusiastic collaborator that works well with team members.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks at once and work to deadlines.
  • Passion for music and helping artists to connect with and build new fanbases

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

job.title: Data Strategy & Analytics Rotation Trainee 2026-2027
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Data Analytics Rotation Training Program aims to provide opportunities for first generation graduates who are looking to build a career in data strategy and analytics professions. This program is open to all, and we strongly encourage first generation graduates to apply.

This is an exciting opportunity to begin working in the music industry as a data professional. The rotation program will begin in August 2027. In addition to developing your analytical and technical skills, this program provides essential background and experience in various analytics and business functions of a music company. You will gain deep knowledge about and contribute to a wide range of areas including record label and album/track release analytics, macro trend analytics, business analytics, charting impact and broader industry performance with the goal of preparing the trainee to become an analytics leader at Sony Music over time. This is a 2-year rotation program, with rotations through 4 departments lasting six months each. This position will be based in the New York City office. However, one of the four rotations may be based internationally (ex. London office). Successful completion of the two-year rotational program may lead to placement in a permanent role in one of our office locations across the U.S. or internationally. We encourage candidates who are open to relocation to apply.

What you'll do:

• Work alongside analytics team members to provide support to various teams including record labels, which will ultimately help drive the success of our artists and their music
• Be directly responsible for transforming data and trends into custom insights and strategic recommendations by using internal data systems, analytics tools of Sony Music's digital partners, and 3rd party data sources
• Perform deep dive analyses from large sets of data and multiple sources to develop business cases and benchmark analysis, monitor the performance of complex projects or educate teams about the latest trends across the music industry, competitors, digital streaming partners, and consumer behavior
• Contribute to the development and execution of impactful reports, dashboards, other tools to be used by numerous departments
• Understand data sources and systems to ensure data integrity and report accuracy
• Learn software and languages such as Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBI, and SQL to push our data and insights to their maximum potential
• Build relationships across multiple teams to pave the way for the future of your analytics career in music

Who you are:

  • This program is open to Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter 2026 and Winter/Spring 2027 college graduates (from an undergraduate or graduate program) who studied in an analytics field such as analytics, finance, economics, computer science, business, statistics, math, or similar studies
    • You are hungry to learn and grow. You are curious, ask questions and get excited about new projects.
    • You have an analytical mindset - able to build a story and draw conclusions from data
    • You are passionate about the music and entertainment business and have a desire to build a career in the industry
    • You have advanced Excel skills (Pivot tables, VLookups, etc.) and experience using PowerPoint
    • You are a pro-active go-getter who can flourish in a fast-paced environment
  • You are familiar with music streaming and social media platforms
  • You are open to relocation (within the U.S. or internationally) upon completion of the two-year rotational program and placement into a permanent role

What we give you:

• You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey
• A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
• An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching

job.title: Digital Marketing Creative Manager – Domestic
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment Indonesia is looking for Domestic Digital Marketing Creative Manager to leads digital campaign strategy and execution for local frontline releases, driving audience growth, fan engagement, and streaming performance across key platforms. Success in this role means turning artist vision into culturally relevant, data-informed campaigns that build strong artist brands and deliver measurable commercial impact.

Platform & Audience Growth
• Drive audience growth and fan engagement across key digital platforms including Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X.
• Identify platform-specific opportunities to increase visibility, discovery, and conversion for releases and artist brands.
• Partner with internal and external teams to deliver compelling digital content, rollout assets, and channel activations.

• Manage campaign execution from pre-release through post-release in close collaboration with marketing, commercial, creative, and artist teams.

Performance Tracking & Insights

• Use data and market insights to refine targeting, content strategy, and platform priorities for local releases.

• Hands-on experience planning and executing digital campaigns across platforms such as Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X.

• Ability to manage multiple releases and campaign timelines while coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Clear communication skills, strong attention to detail, and a passion for music, artists, and local culture.

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time.

What you'll do

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.

  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

What you'll do

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.

job.title: Finance Director - Ceremony of Roses
job.description:
Ceremony of Roses is a global media, branding, design and events company with a full service music merchandise arm, covering every aspect of merchandise sales, production and distribution worldwide.

The Finance Director is responsible for the financial leadership, governance and operational finance management of Ceremony of Roses UK & Probity Merchandise. The role ensures the integrity of financial reporting, compliance, royalty accounting, tax obligations and audit requirements, whilst partnering with leadership to support commercial decision-making and business growth.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the monthly close process, including financial commentary and analysis of performance versus plan and forecast and performing balance sheet reviews. Review royalty statements based on contract terms as needed and reconciliation processes
  • Ensure accurate accounting treatment of inventory, stock movements and related intercompany activity
  • Ensure timely submission of corporate deliverables, including monthly forecasts and annual business plans for current ventures, new acquisitions, and business units
  • Lead the budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes, providing performance analysis, financial insight and modelling to support business objectives and strategic decision-making
  • Develop and maintain reporting packages, including periodic artist and business unit P&Ls. Lead deal analysis for potential artist deals and evaluate financial performance against targets

job.title: VP, D2C Fan Engagement
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a VP, Fan Engagement to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the Fan Engagement function within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C fan engagement across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six spanning creative direction and design systems, design and production, D2C product management, and CRM and lifecycle marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What you'll do:

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Marketing, CRM & Campaign Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C fan engagement partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

How we LEAD: Universal Music Group is seeking a Director, Marketing & Artist Development . This role will serve as a strategic and operational leader for a creative marketing team focused on artist development, release strategy, DSP initiatives, and business operations. Acting as a trusted partner to the EVP, this role will help drive priorities across artist product management, marketing strategy, project execution, team workflow, and cross-functional communication. Key Responsibilities Artist Product Management & Marketing Strategy Lead product management and marketing strategy for priority artists and releases, including singles, EPs, albums, video content, merchandise, D2C initiatives, live events, and other music-related products. Develop and execute marketing, creative, advertising, and artist development plans in partnership with artists, managers, label teams, DSPs, and internal stakeholders. Serve as a key liaison between artist management, label partners, and internal teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment across all phases of a campaign. Build a deep understanding of each artist’s goals, creative vision, audience, and management processes to support effective long-term planning. Develop artist branding and growth strategies across key verticals, including superfans, creative direction, A&R alignment, digital marketing, content, cultural positioning, and fan acquisition. Partner with digital strategy teams to build data-informed plans, evaluate campaign performance, and recommend pivots based on audience behavior, ROI, and market insights. Identify DSP, digital marketing, and emerging platform opportunities that drive artist relevance, engagement, brand awareness, and audience growth. Manage project budgets and ensure resources are aligned with campaign goals and priorities. Project Management & Business Operations Lead day-to-day project management across artist campaigns, DSP initiatives, internal programs, and special projects, ensuring clear timelines, deliverables, agendas, follow-ups, and accountability. Drive operational clarity across the creative marketing team by establishing priorities, owners, next steps, and communication flows that keep projects moving efficiently. Identify blockers, gaps, and risks across projects, escalating and resolving issues as needed to maintain momentum. Oversee team workflows, internal systems, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms to improve efficiency, collaboration, and scalability. Maintain and evolve key resources, including artist development playbooks, industry landscape documents, cultural trend reports, project strategy maps, internal trackers, agendas, recaps, and executive-ready updates. Act as a senior leader within the creative marketing team, helping guide priorities, decision-making, execution, and cross-functional alignment. Support the EVP in tracking high-priority initiatives, preparing updates, and translating strategic decisions into clear action plans. Lead weekly internal meetings and artist-specific discussions to share updates, evaluate priorities, drive ideation, and ensure alignment. Maintain clear communication between A&R, marketing, digital, creative, artist management, DSPs, label partners, international teams, third parties, and executive leadership. Manage artist, management, third-party, and indie label communications, including newsletters, press strategy support, outreach, and brand development initiatives. Mentor and guide team members by providing direction, structure, feedback, and accountability. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in music marketing, artist product management, label operations, artist development, digital marketing, or a related role within the music or entertainment industry. Proven track record leading artist release campaigns across music, video, merchandise, live events, digital marketing, DSP strategy, fan engagement, audience development, and artist branding. Strong understanding of DSPs, digital platforms, fan acquisition, emerging music discovery channels, campaign performance, and data-informed marketing strategy. Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross-functional projects involving artists, managers, label teams, creative teams, digital strategists, DSP partners, third parties, and executive leadership. Strong operational mindset with experience building scalable processes, workflows, templates, team systems, timelines, budgets, and accountability structures. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. How We LEAD Capitol Christian Music Group is seeking a Director, Data & Insights who will leverage analytics across market trends, audience data, and revenue performance to generate actionable insights that inform strategy and optimize business performance for the label. This role partners closely with Marketing, Digital, Senior Leadership, and Artist teams. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and storytelling - turning signals from streaming, digital platforms, social media, and audience behavior into impactful artist and business insights that drive decision-making across the organization. How You’ll CREATE Define and prioritize the analytics roadmap in alignment with label and artist strategy. Translate complex datasets across DSPs, social platforms, audience engagement channels, and market trends into clear insights and compelling narratives for a range of audiences. Partner with cross-functional teams to connect business questions with data-driven answers, helping guide decisions around audience development, marketing and broader business strategy, and artist growth. Identify key trends across streaming and digital platforms, social media, and fan engagement to uncover opportunities for artist growth and audience expansion. Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership, leveraging insights and business context to elevate decision-making and drive impact. Design, develop, and refine analytics tools, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that empower teams to explore insights independently and drive daily engagement with data. Maintain deep knowledge of data and insights tools available across the company and manage relationships with central data teams. Ensure our data infrastructure matches our strategic needs—connecting tools, enhancing data reliability, and improving accessibility. Turn fast-moving, open-ended business questions into structured analyses grounded in data and business understanding. Analyze why initiatives succeed or fall short, producing learnings that inform both near-term decisions and longer-term strategy. Champion a culture of data-informed storytelling, ensuring insights are communicated in clear, visually compelling ways that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences. Ensure weekly reporting, real-time communication on timely priorities, and share regular analysis and insights with label teams. Prepare ad hoc analysis, reports, and presentations as needed. Oversee and mentor the Data Analyst, ensuring quality, clarity, and impact of their work while setting high standards for analytics and execution. Hire and onboard talent as needed; build a culture of ownership, learning, and strong craft. Build a deep understanding of internal stakeholders and artist partners to ensure analytics solutions address the most meaningful business questions and creative opportunities. Bring Your VIBE 6+ years of experience in data analytics, insights, strategy, consulting, or similar analytical roles. Proficiency working with analytical tools including SQL, Python, and similar platforms. Music, media, entertainment, or consumer analytics experience preferred but not required. Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related analytical field. Passion for music, culture, and the evolving ways fans discover and engage with artists. Experience analyzing trends across streaming platforms, social media, and digital consumption patterns. Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, DOMO, or similar platforms to present insights clearly. Familiarity with statistical concepts and analytical methodologies. Experience working with data sources via APIs or large-scale datasets. Advanced Excel skills and comfort building dynamic models when needed. job.title: Administrative Assistant (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Summary/Objective

This role will support the NFL’s departmental leads (three Senior Vice Presidents) with a focus on daily administrative and core operational support across these core functions of the League, in order to drive efficiency and optimize the productivity of these teams and leaders.

General Administrative Support:

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls
  • Manager calendars across different time zones
  • Create and distribute agendas
  • Answer and route telephone calls and incoming mail
  • Arrange and manage travel schedules and travel expenses
  • Track and process P-Card transactions and expenses
  • Prepare meeting materials and presentations
  • Create templates for letters and memos
  • Track and maintain department inventory and materials

Operations Support:

  • Processing of invoices, setting up new vendors and other financial system operations on behalf of the department
  • Creating templated agreements and routing contracts through Docusign and other systems
  • Processing staffing and credential needs for events and meetings
  • Write and issue correspondence to key partners, NFL clubs, vendors, and fans.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting one or more senior leaders, executives, or C-suite stakeholders in an administrative or executive assistant capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, travel arrangements, meeting coordination, and expense reporting.
  • Must have exceptional prioritizing, organizational, communication, initiative, judgment and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and maintain confidentiality in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree from a Four-Year College or University.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Experience within sports, media, entertainment, or a similarly fast-paced corporate environment.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Salary
$35—$35 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered.

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

  • Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.
  • Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.
  • Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.
  • Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
  • Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

job.title: Associate, Hotels & Meetings (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Live Events team is responsible for the planning and execution of the league’s tentpole events and International Games. The Associate position plays an integral role in supporting the Events team with the execution of all tentpole events and executive meetings with a focus on hotel management, meeting planning and execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of 100+ hotel contracts for future Super Bowl and Draft bids and assist with onboarding process through our supplier portal.
  • Assist with the RFP process and hotel sourcing strategy for NFL International Games, which includes identifying and securing staff, vendor, and headquarters hotel accommodations while managing contract negotiations, and working with Finance on budget considerations.
  • Support the Super Bowl hotel assignment process by working closely with departments and partners assigning 20,000 rooms.
  • Manage hotel reservations for 800+ attendees at all tentpole events which include Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, Combine, Draft, Flag Championships, Hall of Fame, Kickoff, International games and meetings.
  • Execute Super Bowl headquarter hotel operations that include contract management, hotel reservations, meeting space logistics, food & beverage, signage, and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate planning meetings across all tentpole events for current year and future. This entails sourcing hotels through our RFP platform and tracking proposals.
  • Lead effort for on-site event management for Owners Meetings and department meetings including room block management, client check-in, credential distribution, and registration.
  • Attend all planning meetings, as needed for current and future tentpole events and outline goals and objectives for each trip.
  • Work cross functionally with various internal departments on meetings throughout the year.
  • Reconcile budgets and invoices with finance team on for all tentpole events and meetings.
  • Support the team in various capacities including contract management, updating the special events calendar and tracking budgets.

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 2 years of hotel with a focus on room management and function room operations
  • Adept at contract negotiations and proven experience working with hotel contracts
  • Hotel and venue management with a focus on room block build/management, attrition mitigation, function room costing and management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to lead others and collaborate with a variety of groups at different levels
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills
  • Strong writing and communications skills

job.title: Director, Communications - Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Communications – Flag Football to lead strategic communications for one of the fastest growing areas of the sport. This role will help grow awareness, credibility, and participation in flag football in the U.S. and internationally, while supporting the NFL’s leadership through NFL FLAG and the broader flag football ecosystem.

The Director will shape the narrative for flag football by elevating stories around access, inclusion, athlete pathways, youth and scholastic participation, community impact, and elite competition. This leader will develop integrated media, content, executive visibility, and thought-leadership strategies tied to major growth moments, including NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, international activations, and the LA28 Olympic Games.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a multi-year communications strategy that advances flag football growth across youth, scholastic, community, elite, and international levels.
  • Lead storytelling, media relations, executive visibility, and issues preparedness tied to LA28, Brisbane 2032, and long-term Olympic inclusion.
  • Create communications and advocacy materials that support NFHS and state association sanctioning efforts, including stakeholder messaging, announcement plans, and media materials.
  • Drive proactive press strategy across national, local, youth/scholastic, community, lifestyle, sports business, and international media.
  • Partner with Football Operations, International, Marketing, Social, Player Engagement, Legends, Clubs, and external partners across the flag football ecosystem.
  • Lead communications planning and on-site media operations for flag-specific showcases, championships, clinics, activations, and relevant NFL tentpole events.
  • Develop message guides, press materials, briefing documents, FAQs, social/content inputs, and partner-facing assets aligned with league style and terminology.
  • Establish communications KPIs, track performance, report progress, and maintain talking points, holding statements, Q&As, and response plans for flag-related issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, corporate communications, brand communications, or sports communications.
  • Proven success in developing communications strategies that drive awareness, engagement, participation, reputation, or business outcomes.
  • Strong media relationships and experience with narrative development, message development, executive communications, and spokesperson preparation.
  • Experience leading communications planning, press operations, and on-site media execution at major events.
  • Ability to translate research, participation trends, insights, and performance metrics into clear, compelling stories.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and composure in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in sports, youth/scholastic programming, community impact, grassroots participation, international communications, or major events.
  • Familiarity with schools, state associations, community organizations, clubs, leagues, federations, or governing bodies.

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is looking for a Director, Stadium Network Architecture with a strong background in network design, engineering, architecture and operations as well as experience with Wireless Design & Spectrum Analysis to join an innovative team of solutions engineers and architects. The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of Football Technology network services considering performance, redundancy, scalability, and security.
    • Document standards and guidelines for best practice stadium network and wireless architecture as they align to industry standards and best practices.
    • Develop and present comprehensive network design proposals to stakeholders, addressing business requirements and technical specifications.
    • Assist in the research, design and documentation for upgrades and adoption of new network technologies.
    • Provide hands on configuration and escalation support for all stadium network technologies.
  • Responsible for the installation, operation, administration, and maintenance of wired and wireless networks at stadiums and corporate offices.
    • Provide dedicated support for on-site stadium network and Wi-Fi technicians during NFL game days throughout the NFL season.
    • Responsible for managing and maintaining network diagrams, configurations, support, and training documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including operations, security, Events, and others to align network strategies with business goals.
    • Responds to technical escalations for wired and wireless service issues, working with product support teams, IT staff and business groups to ensure resolution.
    • Provide reports for network KPIs to show service levels, capacity analysis, performance, troubleshooting, and areas for improvement in network infrastructure.
    • Provide technical support to various activities and internal infrastructure within the Football Technology segment.
    • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
    • Establish and adhere to set project plans and release dates.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior network engineers, sharing expertise and knowledge.
  • Remain on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art network technologies, participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations
  • Maintain and publish Football Stadium DAS and Wi-Fi Guidelines
    • Review and plan DAS and Wi-Fi updates for NFL Tentpole Events.
    • Lead audits of Cellular and DAS Performance around NFL stadiums to adhere to NFL guidelines.
    • Collaborate with Cellular Vendors on stadium enhancements, and testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field preferred, with 10+ years of experience or equivalent military service.
  • Extensive hands-on experience exceeding 10 years in network implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Demonstrated leadership with over 5 years in network architecture roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience in wireless design, implementation, and support for large networks, including spectrum analysis and stadium DAS design.
  • Proficient in network administration, particularly Cisco products, with expertise in controllers, access points, routers, and switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, STP, NAT, IPSEC, GRE, VPC/VSS, etc.)
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts and principles, including but not limited to routing static/dynamic (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, & BGP) and multi-layer switching (standard and private VLANs, VTP, Spanning Tree, etc.)

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong grasp of network best practices, security principles, design architecture, and analysis with use of tools such as Wireshark, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting networking device drivers and client system issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting video and voice performance over wired and wireless networks.
  • Capability to research and evaluate new network technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in creating and updating detailed infrastructure topologies using MS Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine and DNA.

Travel

30% - 50%, domestic and international.

$185,000—$215,000 USD

job.title: Seasonal Customer Support Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media group is seeking a coordinator to assist with supporting various platforms at NFL Media with a focus on customer support for NFL+ and NFL owned and operated apps. This person will be expected to immerse themselves in the details of all digital products and become a communication hub for operational activities. This person should have strong communication skills and confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position communicates with product management, technology, marketing, and sales departments. The Seasonal role will report directly to the Senior Product Operations Manager.

The Customer Support Operations Coordinator will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient and seamless operation of customer support channels for NFL+ streaming service and NFL owned and operated products. This individual will collaborate with customer service partners to optimize processes for Chat, Messaging, Live Chat, Voice, and Email support. They will be responsible for maintaining and updating FAQ content, driving operational efficiency, and ensuring a high-quality customer support experience across all touchpoints. Coordinate and support Tier-1 and Tier-2 requests from fans and direct-to-consumer subscribers. Report any trends seen while managing tickets. Use several databases, portals, and consoles to perform several account functions.

Responsibilities

  • Support Channel Optimization:
    • Work closely with customer service partners to identify, assess, and implement improvements in support channels including Chat, Messaging, Live Chat, Voice, and Email.
  • Process Improvement:
    • Analyze customer service workflows and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • FAQ Content Management:
    • Regularly update and manage the FAQ content for accuracy and relevance, ensuring it reflects the most up-to-date information for NFL+ streaming and other NFL products.
  • Zendesk Management:
    • Utilize Zendesk to monitor, track, and manage customer inquiries, ensuring that tickets are handled efficiently and effectively.
  • System Proficiency:
    • Leverage tools such as Chatbot AI, Voice AI, Postman, NFL apps, and social media platforms to provide seamless support for both internal teams and customers.
  • Social Media Monitoring:
    • Monitor and engage with customer feedback, questions, and issues across social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) to ensure a timely response and resolution of concerns. Identify trends and recurring issues from social media to inform customer service strategies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration:
    • Collaborate with various departments (Product, Marketing, IT, etc.) to ensure customer support needs are met and product updates are effectively communicated to support teams.
  • Performance Tracking:
    • Monitor and report on key metrics to assess the effectiveness of customer support channels, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring KPIs are met.
  • Training and Support:
    • Assist in training new agents and supporting existing team members by providing updates and ensuring they are equipped with the necessary resources to handle customer issues.
  • Customer Feedback Analysis:
    • Collect and analyze customer feedback from multiple channels (including social media) to identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to implement solutions.

    • Identify and resolve operational issues, escalating problems as necessary to ensure timely resolution. Try to reproduce reported issues and then send to development team.
    • Update content in the CMS as requested.

    • Provide support for NFL+ subscriptions, including plans, billing, renewals, cancellations, payments, and access issues across devices
    • Clearly explain auto-renewal, billing cycles, and eligibility; ensure alignment with NFL+ policies
    • Produce weekly support reports (ticket trends, CSAT, SLA, contact drivers, AI deflection, escalations, live event insights)

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3+ years’ experience coordinating and supporting digital products in a sports entertainment, digital, media or related industry
  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, preferably within a tech or streaming service environment.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change
  • Must be able to work all NFL Game Days, including Preseason, Regular Season and Playoffs, in-office.
  • Must be able to work on holidays (e.g. Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve, New Year's).

  • Proficiency in customer support platforms including Zendesk, Postman, NFL apps, and social media monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of customer service best practices and multi-channel support strategies.
  • Experience managing and updating knowledge bases or FAQ content.
  • Experience in social media monitoring and engagement, with a focus on customer service.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track and report on support performance metrics.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor of Science or Arts degree in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field is preferred.

  • Ability to understand and document business rules
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems and programs
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football
  • Excels collaborating with teams

job.title: Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, Australia
job.description:
The Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, is a key part of the global consumer products team, responsible for identifying Consumer Products opportunities, setting the strategy for NFL emerging markets and accelerating revenue growth across international CP. This role will work closely with the international strategy team, local GMs, and cross functions across the organization to identify new market opportunities and drive long term brand expansion and fandom in key emerging regions around the world. The ideal candidate brings deep international licensing experience, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for growing sport globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute NFL’s international licensing strategy across emerging markets, including, APAC and Middle East.
  • Build licensing agency strategy for key emerging markets. Identify best in class agency partners and manage these relationships.
  • Lead relationship with licensing agencies on record on expansion into key regions.
  • Identify, negotiate, and manage new licensing agreements with regional and local partners across apparel, accessories, and lifestyle products; partner with licensing agency where relevant.
  • Collaborate with international marketing teams to build programs and campaigns that drive revenue and support fan growth.
  • Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape to inform licensing strategy and product portfolio.
  • Build locally relevant programs and story telling relevant to each market/region.
  • Partner with Events team on any local in-market fan events, developing event-based retail presence and execution.
  • Manage ongoing relationships with licensees, including business reviews, product approvals, assortment planning, etc.
  • Develop and manage key retailer relationships within each market/region.
  • Develop annual consumer products business plan for each region and update quarterly.
  • Partner with Sponsorship on identifying and executing joint commercial opportunities.
  • Own local city or stakeholder relationship from a licensing perspective.
  • Track KPIs, forecast revenue, and provide regular business reporting to senior leadership.

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, MBA preferred
  • 8+ years experience in sports licensing, with a strong emphasis on international expansion
  • Proven track record of negotiating and managing complex partner agreements across multiple regions, specifically APAC and MENA
  • Experience with licensing agency selection and management
  • Deep understanding of APAC and MENA retail landscapes, sports product distribution models, and building market entry strategies, including branded retail

consistency without slowing teams down unnecessarily Track recurring weaknesses, recommend structural fixes, and help leadership understand where engineering investment will reduce risk most experience with SSDLC and shift-left practices, including automated code review support, threat modeling, security design review, and vulnerability management Strong understanding of application and API security, including common software weaknesses, authN/authZ, secrets handling, dependency risk, injection, deserialization, and data protection Experience integrating reliable, scalable, and job.description: Job Title Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust Job Description About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take charge of our data privacy and platform strategy.
