Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com USA TODAY Executive Editor of Audience and Digital Production Role summary USA TODAY is seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production to serve as key driver of USA TODAY’s digital audience strategy and the executive owner of newsroom digital production across platforms. In one of the most critical leadership roles in our organization, this editor will set the agenda for how USA TODAY’s journalism is transformed into signature digital experiences that grow reach, deepen engagement, and build enduring reader loyalty. Reporting directly to the SVP of USA TODAY, the Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production will own and evolve the operating model for audience and production bringing together dedicated digital content pillar teams, platform owners, and a 24/7 central digital production desk into a cohesive, high performing system. They will oversee a sophisticated organization that spans our core editorial pillars, enterprise level planning, and experts across web, apps, newsletters, video, social and emerging platforms, ensuring that every major story and franchise is executed with clarity, speed and impact. This executive will be accountable for portfolio wide digital performance, including growth in loyal users, repeat visitation, engagement depth, and conversion into newsletters and other owned channels. They will work as a true peer and strategic partner to pillar leaders across News/Life, Opinion, Sports and Entertainment shaping digital growth priorities, championing big bet projects, and making data driven decisions about where, when and how USA TODAY shows up for its audiences. Central to the role is building a modern, scalable operating system for digital journalism. The Executive Editor will design and continuously refine workflows that make our coverage data informed, visually distinctive and relentlessly aligned to USA TODAY’s brand promise and enterprise priorities. They will lead a disciplined culture of experimentation standing up formal testing programs for formats, distribution strategies and audience journeys, and integrating responsible AI assisted tools into daily production in ways that strengthen quality, speed and efficiency. As a senior newsroom executive, this editor will lead, inspire and develop a high caliber team of managers, editors, producers and platform specialists. They will be expected to set a clear vision, translate it into concrete operating standards, and build an inclusive, performance driven culture grounded in candor, coaching and accountability. This leader will ensure that audience insight, platform intelligence and journalistic ambition come together in a unified strategy. The ideal candidate will bring a track record of leading complex digital news operations at scale, deep fluency in audience analytics and platform dynamics, and a demonstrated ability to drive change in fast moving environments. They will combine urgency and creativity with sound judgment and integrity and will be energized by the opportunity to build a flagship audience and digital production organization that positions USA TODAY to win the next decade of digital news. This role must be based out of Washington, DC or NYC. Responsibilities: Own the audience strategy across platforms • Set and communicate the audience and distribution strategy for USA TODAY’s digital portfolio, with a birds-eye view of business needs and growth targets. • Ensure the structure intentionally integrates newsletters, social discovery, video/visuals distribution, search, and AI support across all pillars. Accountable for performance, KPIs, and division goals • Monitor performance against key metrics (pageviews, unique visits, return visits, loyalty, platform growth) and be accountable for hitting audience and engagement goals. • Close the loop between data and editorial decisions by ensuring platform owners and pod leads act on live analytics and audience insights. Leadership of the Compass operating model • Lead and oversee the full Audience & Digital Production structure: digital content pillar team owners, platform owners, and central desk, under one unified model. • Maintain a cohesive view of the entire portfolio and resolve conflicts or prioritization questions between pillars, platforms, and central desk. • Serve as key advisor to executive leadership on audience strategy and digital production capacity. Planning, tentpoles, and live coverage • Own the daily and look-ahead planning calendar, including tentpole events, live moments, and major initiatives. • Ensure the central desk and pods execute against agreed strategies in fast-moving scenarios (breaking news, major sporting events, large entertainment initiatives). Cross functional partnership and prioritization • Partner cross-departmentally and cross-divisionally (News, Entertainment, Sports, Opinion, Product, Sales, Brand, Local, Content Strategy, Content Monetization) to align audience priorities with business objectives. • Participate in and help lead the Audience Growth Council with platform owners and pillar leads. Standards, brand voice, and editorial quality • Monitor site content and editorial standards from an audience perspective, ensuring brand voice and platform strategies are coherent and consistent. • Maintain clear decision rights so pods own creation, platform editors own how each platform wins, and central desk executes in real time. Workflow, innovation, and AI integration • Champion the integration of AI and innovation tools (SEO drafts, content tagging, briefings, social copy) into production workflows, in collaboration with platform owners and Content AI teams. • Ensure the team’s structure supports scaling, pivoting, and experimentation across emerging platforms and formats. People leadership and structure optimization • Hire, manage, and develop senior editors (Central Desk & Operations, Platforms, Pods) and ensure clear reporting lines and responsibilities across the 23–30 person model. • Adjust staffing assumptions, meeting cadence, decision rights, and role scopes based on operating experience, with regular reviews and model refinements. Key deliverables: • A functioning hybrid team (pods + platforms + central desk) that delivers 24/7 digital publishing, clear ownership by pillar, and expert platform stewardship. • Documented audience strategies per pillar and platform, tied to measurable KPIs and reviewed quarterly. • A central desk and platform owner layer that reliably execute homepage, alerts, newsletters, social and search strategies under pressure. • Integrated AI and innovation workflows that measurably improve speed, depth, and scalability of digital production. Requirements: • Significant leadership experience in digital newsrooms or audience/production teams, preferably at national scale. • Proven track record driving audience growth across multiple platforms (site, app, newsletters, social, video, search, aggregators). • Strong fluency in audience analytics and the ability to translate data into clear editorial and distribution decisions. • Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and complex, multi-team operating models. • Comfort leading change, including reorganization, workflow design, and adoption of new tools (especially AI and automation in production). Application Instructions We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit: 1. Your resume – one to two pages. 2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the role. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. #Newsgnt #LI-NC1 The annualized base salary for this role will range between $163,000 and $175,000. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. A Little Bit About Our Team The Corporate Finance Department at WMG oversees the Company’s financial operations in partnership with WMG’s labels, business units and corporate functions. The team is responsible for financial planning and analysis, budgeting and forecasting, management reporting, accounting oversight and financial compliance across the Company. Your Role Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, the Senior Analyst will play a hands-on role in the management of centrally managed Corporate functions and Recorded Music functional areas. You will take ownership of key day-to-day budgeting, forecasting, reporting and accounting activities for Corporate functions. Acting as a key finance partner, you will help department leaders understand their financial performance, lead their budgets and make informed business decisions. This is a hands-on role offering broad exposure to the financial operation of a global music company, regular interaction with finance and non-finance stakeholders, and the opportunity to develop within a collaborative, high-performing team. Here You'll Get To:. Own key monthly close activities for Corporate functions, including preparing accruals, reclasses and intercompany journal entries. Work closely with the Shared Service Center and other Finance teams to ensure costs are accurately recorded in the general ledger and align with Company policies. Prepare comprehensive month-end reporting packages and monthly forecast materials, including analysis of material spend and variances against budget, forecast and prior year. Partner with Corporate function leaders and budget owners to understand financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts. Support the annual budget, monthly forecasting and long-range planning processes, including the development and maintenance of supporting financial models. Compile and analyze Corporate spend information used in senior-management, Board and external reporting materials. Provide financial oversight of operational activities, including invoice coding and submissions, vendor setup, purchase order tracking, commitments and project cash-outflows. Maintain strong follow-up on outstanding items, results and forecast assumptions across multiple collaborators. Continuously find opportunities to automate processes, improve financial controls and streamline recurring reporting. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can translate complex financial information into clear business insights. You can work independently, take ownership of assignments and collaborate effectively as part of a broader team. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and explain financial information clearly to non-finance leaders and global stakeholders. You can manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment. You demonstrate strong attention to detail, accountability and follow-through on open items and assignments. job.title: Correspondent, Technology, APAC
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is looking for a talented, experienced and versatile reporter to join our Business team to cover technology in Asia. The contest between the United States and China for technological supremacy – spanning artificial intelligence, semiconductors, robotics and other emerging fields – is one of the defining stories of our time. We are looking for a journalist who can break news from companies and governments across Asia and translate complex technical developments into clear and compelling journalism for a broad audience. A firm understanding of the geopolitical context to technology is necessary. China will be central to the beat, reflecting its importance to the region and the global economy.

The ideal candidate is an energetic and determined beat reporter who thrives on competition and ambitious storytelling. The role calls for a rich mix of scoops, breaking news, analysis, explainers and enterprise reporting that reveals the forces reshaping technology, business and geopolitics. Although the reporting will begin in Asia, stories must draw wider global connections. The reporter will work closely with correspondents around the world and collaborate across Business, International, Breaking News, Video and Graphics, contributing to articles, live coverage, newsletters, audio, visual journalism and other formats.

This role will be based in the APAC region; the location of the role will be discussed with the recruiter during the interview process. The role will be part of the Technology Team on the Business Desk.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Follow news, events and cultural trends on your beat to determine, in conjunction with your colleagues and editors, themes worthy of coverage as breaking news, day news or as enterprise
  • Must be as comfortable and enthusiastic reacting to immediate breaking news as you are writing thoughtfully and deeply about events and issues
  • Write medium- and long-term enterprise and the occasional entertaining feature.
  • Deliver scoops and exclusive news
  • Build a network of sources that will inform rich and original news articles and features
  • Contribute to and sometimes be the lead correspondent on live briefings, writing briefing-length stories and providing live coverage
  • Cover news accurately and efficiently; maintain and cultivate news sources and contacts; obtain information through interviews, observations and research
  • Present facts and analysis in clear written form and in conformity with Times style, length and other requirements, and developing high-impact stories from the broader themes that underpin incremental news developments
  • Write on deadline; receive and react to feedback and edits
  • Collaborate closely and regularly with reporter-researchers who are partners in reporting, translation and story scouting
  • Commit to The New York Times’s strategy, ethics, standards and mission for both themselves, their team, stringers and colleagues
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Our ideal candidate has:

  • A bottomless curiosity about the world and a love of news and storytelling
  • A self-evident commitment to the power of tough and fair reporting
  • An ability to produce stories that are crisply written and well organized, framed to draw in busy, scrolling readers and delivered in language that is accessible
  • A striving passion for professional development and the ability to learn from everyone around them
  • A collaborative, genuine and independent spirit that takes satisfaction in not only their own growth but the success of their team and colleagues
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in reporting roles

The closing date for applications is September 22, 2026. To be considered, please submit your resume, cover letter and links to your top 5-7 clips.

job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We’re hiring an administrative assistant to support the Executive Assistant to the Founders Office with the fast-moving personal, family, and logistical needs of Axios co-founders Jim VandeHei and Mike Allen.

Why it matters: This role will provide essential administrative support to the Founders Office, helping keep personal logistics, travel details, expenses, family needs, and other recurring tasks organized and moving with care, discretion and strong follow-through.

Go deeper: This is a full-time support role for someone who is energized by high-trust, high-context work and wants to grow in an executive support environment.

  • The puzzle: How do you help the Founders Office run more smoothly by taking ownership of the details that can otherwise slow the system down? Bonus: you’re excited to use AI tools to make admin workflows smarter, faster and more organized.
  • The support: You’ll report to the Executive Assistant and help create more capacity across the Founders Office by managing recurring logistics, personal tasks, family-related needs and administrative follow-through.
  • The mix: This role will include personal and family logistics, travel support, expenses, vendor coordination, errands, appointments, gifting, events and other administrative needs.
  • The pace: Jim and Mike move quickly, and their personal and professional logistics often overlap. The right person will be calm, organized and responsive as details shift, including occasional time-sensitive needs outside standard business hours.
  • The orbit: You’ll work closely with the Chief of Staff and other key stakeholders around Jim and Mike, supporting the broader system that keeps the founders’ lives and work moving.
  • The opportunity: This is a great role for someone earlier in their administrative career who wants to learn how a high-functioning executive office works and grow into broader administrative or executive support responsibilities over time.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody a proactive, entrepreneurial spirit, demonstrate a passion for Axios’ mission and have the following skills:

  • 1-3 years of administrative, executive support, family office, personal assistant or high-touch operations experience

job.title: Brand & Sync Partnerships Director
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Sync Partnerships Director to join UnitedMasters!

What You'll Do

  • Identify, qualify, and close new customer accounts to achieve and exceed sales targets
  • Develop account plans to increase adoption and grow key accounts.
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers and client champions in key accounts.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies tailored to key accounts.
  • Manage pipeline to keep forecasts and deals status effectively communicated across the organization.
  • Shape complex deals and negotiate contracts to closure, working closely with legal teams
  • Create a meaningful presence for the company in related industry events.
  • Partner with UnitedMasters’ Music, Product, and Marketing teams to analyze market trends, deepen understanding of customer needs, refine unique selling propositions and continually improve messaging.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and competitive landscape

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven ability to set goals and work cross-functionally to establish a strong market presence and revenue.
  • You have a track record in contributing to culture, process and cross-functional collaboration to enable business success.
  • Ability to travel and host events to nurture and deepen client relationships

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience and extensive relationships selling campaign-based and/or program-based programs to Creative / Content / Marketing departments.
  • Proven network of contacts across Creative / Content / Marketing landscapes in Advertising, Sports, Digital Publishing, or Media within the US with a proven track record closing deals.
  • Passionate about all genres of music and constantly evaluating new trends in the ever-changing music landscape
  • Distinct point of view on where the industry is heading and ability to inform how UnitedMasters can leverage its position in culture and independent music distribution to build sustainable competitive advantages in sync.
  • An empathetic problem solver who is closely attuned to our company’s values and those of the independent artists we serve.
  • You are an entrepreneur at heart: You are driven and self-directed. You are confident and energized about building through new stages of growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Music Industry, or a related field.
  • Mastery of CRM software, such as Hubspot or Salesforce
  • Deep experience in selling Music to Creative Teams with a track record of success

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $130k-$160k + Commission + Equity

Build your skills, grow your network, and get an inside look at life behind the headlines. Want to get your foot in the door of the sports media world and work with one of the most iconic sports brands out there? The New York Post’s Sports Social Media team is on the hunt for an enthusiastic and creative Sports Social Media Intern (24 hours a week) to help engage our massive sports audience, spotlight viral content, and keep the Post’s sports coverage front and center! If you live and breathe sports, have a knack for social media, and want to be part of the action this summer, we want you on our team! You’ll work with some of the most passionate and experienced sports editors and social media managers in the industry. This is a real chance to make an impact—help grow our already massive audience, engage with die-hard fans, and contribute to content that gets people talking. Note: This internship is scheduled to run from September 14, 2026 - November 20, 2026 . Open to current juniors and seniors pursuing a BA, MA students, and recent graduates who completed their degree within the past year. Note: This position requires in-office attendance at our Midtown Manhattan office. What You’ll Do: Engage with readers across social platforms to amplify our sports coverage and build excitement around major events. Curate and share viral sports content to keep our social feeds buzzing. Help manage the New York Post's sports social media accounts, making sure we stay ahead of trends and always bring our audience the latest and greatest in sports. Self-starter with an ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Significant understanding of digital technologies, especially music platforms and mobile apps. Strong organizational skills including follow-through and execution. Exceptional communication skills, both verbal & written. Passion for music and digital music platforms. Preferred Skills/Abilities : Fluency in Spanish or another language is a bonus. Advanced knowledge of Office 365 including Excel. Experienced in working with large datasets and / or databases including SQL language. Excellent presentation skills (e.g., PowerPoint) along with a willingness to speak publicly amongst peers and senior managers. How you'll CREATE: Assess & review online uses of UMG digital and physical assets (including publishing), to detect infringement of our rights. Handling inquiries from our internal business units and labels (including Spanish-speaking labels). Work with our international trade groups to enforce our rights. Staying abreast of digital trends related to the recording industry. Overview:

 

The Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager, reporting to the SEM Product Manager, is an integral member of Audacy’s centralized Revenue Operations Search team. This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

  • Manage multiple accounts, requests and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and proactively communicating priorities, concerns or potential delays

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

Overview:

 

Audacy Richmond seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for Virginia-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

Audacy Buffalo seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).
  • Radio or audio industry background a bonus.

Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace?

Audacy is looking for a driven Digital Account Executive to accelerate growth and make an immediate impact. This is more than a sales job—it's an opportunity to build your own book of business, sell industry-leading digital marketing solutions, and earn without limits.

 

If you're competitive, entrepreneurial, and motivated by uncapped income potential, we'll give you the platform, products, and support to win big.

 

Who We Are: Industry Digital Leader with Best In Class Technology

 

At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition. You'll collaborate with local businesses, regional brands, and national advertisers to create customized marketing strategies using cutting-edge digital solutions.

  • Digital Streaming Audio
  • Podcast Advertising & Host-Endorsed Content
  • Amazon DSP & Programmatic Advertising
  • Connected TV (CTV) & OTT Video / Live Sports
  • Display & Native Advertising
  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM)

  • Own the Close: Take control of the entire sales process, from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Compete to Win: Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where results are recognized and rewarded.
  • Sell Industry-Leading Solutions: Help businesses grow with best-in-class digital marketing solutions.
  • Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand client goals, uncover challenges, and deliver strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Outwork the Competition: Stay ahead of market trends, identify emerging opportunities, and bring fresh ideas to every client conversation.

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

 

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

Qualifications

More About You:

  • Proven Sales Success: 4+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience with a track record of winning new business and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Hunter Mentality: You thrive on prospecting, opening doors, and building a pipeline from the ground up.
  • Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of digital advertising solutions, including programmatic, search, social, video, and audience targeting.
  • Strategic & Consultative Approach: You uncover client challenges, develop customized solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Executive Presence: Confident presenting to business owners, marketing leaders, and C-suite decision-makers while simplifying complex digital strategies.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable using campaign metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROI, ROAS, and conversion rates to guide recommendations and prove performance.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills that drive long-term partnerships.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Salesforce, Google Workspace, and digital marketing platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.
  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated, accountable, and driven to succeed in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.

  • Hit & Exceed Goals: Staying driven to hit your revenue targets and grow your own income.

  • The Pitch & Prospect Mindset: You enjoy business development. Cold calling, networking, and creating opportunities from scratch energizes you.

  • Essentials: A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

  • Uncapped Earnings: Base salary + aggressive commission structure.

  • Culture: A collaborative, fast-moving, and supportive group that values fresh ideas and celebrates wins together.

If you're ready to take ownership of your earning potential and bring fresh energy to the Bay Area media landscape, apply today.

Tired of the LA hustle? Thinking about moving to Las Vegas? You'll be in good company—plenty of Californians have already made the move. If you're looking for a fresh start and a great career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!  

We are seeking a creative, high-energy, and multi-talented Social Media Producer & Graphic Designer to join our media team. This dual-focused role is perfect for a digital storyteller who can seamlessly blend community management with striking visual design.

In this role, you will be the creative force behind five of our distinct radio station brands, driving audience engagement through dynamic social content (video, graphics and written content). Additionally, you will serve as the go-to visual designer for our digital sales team, crafting high-impact marketing collateral, client pitch decks, and digital advertisements that drive revenue.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

Social Media Producer & Content Creation (Approx. 60%)

  • Multi-Account Management: Oversee, curate, and maintain the daily social media presence across multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, etc.) for five unique radio station brands.
  • Content Production: Concept, shoot, edit, and publish high-performing multimedia content, with a heavy emphasis on short-form video (Reels, TikToks), on-air talent features, station events, and pop-culture trends.
  • Brand Voice & Engagement: Maintain the distinct personality and voice of each station while actively engaging with followers, listeners, and influencers to build community.
  • Analytics & Growth: Track performance metrics across all platforms, adjusting strategies based on data to optimize reach, engagement, and follower growth.

Graphic Design & Sales Support (Approx. 40%)

  • Digital Sales Collateral: Partner with the digital sales team to design compelling media kits, client pitch decks, and sponsorship presentations.
  • Ad & Event Creative: Create eye-catching digital display ads, website banners, concert/event flyers, and promotional graphics for station clients and internal marketing campaigns.
  • Brand Consistency: Ensure all visual assets comply with individual station brand guidelines while pushing the creative envelope.

  • Video Savvy: Strong mobile video shooting and editing skills (using CapCut, Premiere, or in-app tools) tailored for Reels and TikTok.
  • Chameleon-Like Creativity: Ability to switch gears quickly between a New/Talk station’s informational aesthetic, a pop station’s high-energy vibe, and a polished corporate sales deck.

job.title: Field Engineer
job.description: Overview Called to K-LOVE Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus At K-LOVE, every role is ministry. We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence. If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading. Do you feel called to use your gifts to serve something bigger than yourself? K-LOVE inspires people to move closer to Jesus. Every signal we send carries hope, truth, and transformation into homes, cars, and communities. Behind that mission is a team of engineers who see their work as more than technical - it's eternal. Join our team as a Field Engineer, where you'll be at the forefront of ensuring K-LOVE programming is broadcast seamlessly and at the highest quality. From diverse locations to dynamic work environments, you’ll play a crucial role in supporting broadcast facilities with top-notch technical and engineering expertise. Ready to make an impact in the world of broadcast? This is the role for you! What will you do? Evaluates the overall technical operation of facilities within area of responsibility and takes corrective action as necessary to ensure equipment is functioning to the highest level of quality. Install, maintain, and repair broadcast equipment (such as audio processors, mixers, microwave and satellite equipment) used in preparing and transmitting K-LOVE’s programming to the highest possible level of quality. Regularly operate equipment that regulates the signal strength, clarity, and sound of K-LOVE’s broadcasts. Maintain knowledge of applicable FCC rules and regulations and ensure all equipment within area of responsibility is operating safely and legally. Proactively analyze and fix technical faults on equipment and systems to the component level. Partner and communicate with contract engineers to resolve technical problems. Evaluate work quality from contract engineers and assist in coordinating and reviewing contract engineer projects. Proactively communicate and work with other staff to resolve technical problems. From time to time, carry out work on non-broadcast equipment (such as electrical generators, air conditioning units, light fixtures, plumbing fixtures, etc.) as conditions dictate. Make trips to sites, as required, performing installations or repairs; or company headquarters as needed for training or special projects. The length of these trips varies depending on the specific needs. Maintain professional competency, knowledge and skills necessary to effectively perform job duties by taking personal responsibility for professional development and training. If assigned, serve as Chief Operator/Engineer for one or more broadcast station(s). Carry out other duties as assigned by supervisor. What are we looking for? Bachelor’s degree or equivalent college or technical studies in electronics, communications, or related field(s), or three more years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience. SBE Certification highly desirable. 3+ years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing failures in broadcast electronic equipment, or similar relevant experience. Thorough understanding of the components necessary in a broadcast air-chain. Proven ability to deal with multiple, simultaneous problems in a systematic, logical manner. Ability to read and understand electronic schematics, electrical drawings, and construction drawings, making appropriate modifications when necessary. Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to carry out calculations in common broadcast-related formulae such as transmitter efficiency, transmitter power output, wavelengths, and antenna system gain. Intermediate understanding of satellite technology. Thorough understanding of radio frequency emissions. Ability to solder and desolder electronic components without causing damage to the components or PC board. Knowledge of broadcast-related FCC rules and regulations. Ability to apply common-sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in oral, written or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situation. Ability to think logically from problem to solution. Proficiency with standard broadcast test equipment, such as VOMs, Oscilloscopes, and Spectrum Analyzers. Proficiency with MS Office products and other common software (internet browsers, etc.). What can we offer you? Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage Short/long term disability and life insurance Robust 401K with company match Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more Leadership and Career Development Programs Why work for K-LOVE? K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. “As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, p ursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act. ”

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America , reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined; We’re the largest podcast publisher , with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers , who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio , from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: Premiere Networks is looking for a detail-oriented Sales Planner to help bring national advertising campaigns to life. In this role, you'll work closely with sales and operations teams to build media proposals, manage inventory, process advertising orders, and ensure campaigns are executed seamlessly. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working with data, and love being at the center of cross-functional collaboration, we'd love to hear from you! What You'll Do: Develop and manage national advertising proposals for agencies and clients, ensuring recommendations align with campaign goals, inventory availability, and revenue objectives. Partner closely with Account Executives, Revenue Management, Traffic, and Sales Operations teams to build accurate media plans and support the sales process from proposal through execution. Process advertising orders and manage daily campaign clearances, ensuring schedules are accurate, approved, and executed according to client expectations. Monitor inventory availability and utilization across Premiere Networks programming, helping maximize revenue opportunities while maintaining inventory integrity. Review pricing and inventory allocations to ensure campaigns are booked appropriately and inventory is used efficiently. Provide ongoing support for active campaigns, including order revisions, schedule changes, issue resolution, and client-related requests. Maintain accurate records and data within company systems, generating reports and insights that support sales and revenue performance. Communicate effectively across multiple departments to resolve issues, gather information, and ensure campaigns move smoothly from order to air. What You'll Need: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, tight deadlines, and a high volume of requests in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize large volumes of email communication while maintaining a high level of accuracy and responsiveness. Experience working across multiple software platforms simultaneously; proficiency with Microsoft Excel is preferred and experience with Salesforce is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend effective solutions. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across sales, operations, traffic, and finance teams. Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy when handling proposals, orders, pricing, and inventory management. job.description: The E.W. This role focuses on the products behind Scripps Sports, with an emphasis on the AI and automation tools supporting the sports division. This role ensures initiatives are well-defined, properly tracked and delivered in a way that supports Scripps' broader transformation goals, acting as the connective tissue between business stakeholders, team partners, data and software engineering. The Product Manager should have an analytical mindset, with comfort digging into data to validate a hypothesis or size an opportunity. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Help translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Own the day-to-day management of your product's backlog in Atlassian (Jira), including writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritization. Partner with engineering to plan sprints, track delivery progress and unblock issues as they arise. Support tracking of milestones and impact, escalating risks or hygiene issues proactively. Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate assumptions and ensure what gets built actually solves the intended problem. Help identify interdependencies between your initiatives and other pods' work, flagging conflicts early. Contribute to roadmap planning and sequencing discussions, bringing data and user insight to prioritization conversations. Communicate progress and blockers clearly to your Product Lead and stakeholders. Build low-fidelity prototypes and mockups (e.g., Figma, wireframes) to validate concepts with stakeholders before committing engineering resources. Use prototypes to pressure-test assumptions and surface edge cases. Identify opportunities within your pod's initiatives where AI or automation could improve speed, quality or cost , and help scope them appropriately, and identify systemic solutions to the business problem. Partner with the AI/architecture team to understand platform capabilities (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio) and translate them into practical product use cases. WHAT YOU'LL NEED: Bachelor's degree preferred; or equivalent work experience preferred Generally, 3+ years digital and product management experience or related field WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Experience in product management, software development, data engineering, or technical project coordination. The ability to explain a technical tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder and vice versa. Basic familiarity with agile/scrum practices and tools like Jira or similar work-management platforms. Experience with data analysis and interpreting performance metrics. Comfortable working across disciplines including engineering, UX, and marketing. #LI-SM2 #REMOTE If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. job.description: #WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. Overview: As the Senior Director, Biddable Platforms Performance, you will develop strategic recommendations and own performance for paid user acquisition of biddable media across social and programmatic channels, as well as programmatic/DSP investment for the full Paramount+ title portfolio. You will help shape the vision, in partnership with senior leadership, for how paid social and programmatic media drive efficient, scalable subscriber and engagement growth. Directing multiple large campaigns across genres and translating business goals into channel strategy, audience approach, and measurable performance targets. You will lead and develop a team of paid media specialists across social and programmatic disciplines, while also managing media partner relationships and multi-million dollar media budgets across channels. This is a senior leadership role accountable for results across multiple campaigns, channels, and disciplines. Requiring solid people leadership, sound judgment on decisions that carry real business risk, and the ability to drive priorities and influence direction across the organization. This is an on-site position, based at our New York City office. Responsibilities include but not limited to: Develop and execute the paid media acquisition strategy across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic/DSP channels (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, Samsung DSP), aligning channel and audience approach to the business goals across all genres. Own CPA and efficiency targets across the portfolio and across channels (e.g., sports, drama, reality, and service titles), continually optimizing tactics, media mix, and audience targeting to scale acquisition cost-effectively. Lead development of audience targeting and consolidation strategy across social and programmatic, including genre-level segmentation and cross-platform/cross-channel audience consolidation, to improve scale and efficiency. Lead activation of incrementality and platform/channel performance testing in partnership with internal testing teams. Provide feasibility guidance on the testing roadmap across social and programmatic, turning learnings into action. Own media recommendations and launch support for key title releases and seasonal tentpoles across channels, ensuring the full paid media mix is positioned to deliver against goals. Lead, coach, and develop the paid media team across social and programmatic disciplines, setting priorities, standards, and clear expectations to build a robust, high-performing function. Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing teams and senior leadership on budget, reporting, and strategic decisions, and represent paid social and programmatic in broader team planning. Basic Qualifications: 12+ years of experience in paid media/digital performance marketing across paid social and programmatic channels, with 5+ years of people management experience leading teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Additional Qualifications: Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and drive priorities for multiple large paid media programs across paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic DSPs (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, TTD), with deep, hands-on channel expertise. Hands-on experience planning, executing, and optimizing programmatic campaigns within at least one major DSP. Experience with audience and inventory targeting, bid strategy, and PMPs/private marketplace deals. Deep track record owning CPA and efficiency targets and managing large media budgets across channels and formats to performance goals. Experience developing audience strategy, testing for incrementality, and platform/channel testing, and using measurement to inform decisions. Exemplary cross-functional leadership and communication skills. With experience partnering with marketing, strategy, and senior stakeholders. Sound judgment on decisions that carry business risk, and the ability to recommend resourcing and staffing to meet objectives. Solid data and analytics fluency, including comfort with platform/DSP reporting, BI tools, and experimentation or measurement frameworks to turn performance data into decisions. Hands-on platform experience across social and/or programmatic and a working command of the day-to-day execution the team performs, while now leading strategy rather than executing in-platform. Experience in entertainment, streaming, or media/subscription businesses. Experience with social ad management/ad-serving platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Smartly, CM360) and/or programmatic DSPs beyond DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, and Samsung DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, StackAdapt). Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana). Relevant platform or DSP certifications (e.g., Meta Blueprint, DV360 Certification) or equivalent. Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions. job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Application submissions for Office of the General Counsel (Copyright) Externship

  • Summer 2027 will close on Sunday, October 18th at 11:59pm ET.

Program Duration:

  • Externs work from May 10, 2027 - August 13, 2027 (dates may be flexible depending on school requirements)

Legal externs are vital contributors to the work of the Office of the General Counsel (“OGC”). The OGC is responsible for providing high-quality, cost-efficient, legal and related services to our NPR clients to achieve its mission of service to the public.

NPR is looking for a 2L or 3L who has a strong interest in copyright law, has taken a course in copyright law, and has comprehensive knowledge of basic copyright principles and fair use. The externship will provide an excellent opportunity to gain a greater understanding of the many legal issues involved in fair use analysis, rights management, and the audio licensing process.

NPR offers legal externships throughout the year. Course credit may be obtained by arrangement with individual law schools. During the summer, law clerks are expected to work full-time, 40 hours per week for 12 weeks. Fall and Spring externships can be on a part-time schedule (usually 15-20 hours per week) or a full-time schedule. Fall and Spring externships must be for course credit.

Responsibilities

The extern will gain practical experience working on issues related to copyright, fair use, and audio licensing, which will include assisting senior counsel with the following tasks:

  • Evaluating copyright issues in audio content (and occasional video content).
  • Researching copyright issues.
  • Making fair use determinations.
  • Drafting and/or organizing permissions agreements and otherwise assessing legal aspects of proposed licensing agreements.
  • Assisting with Rights Management issues.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fair Use Law experience and/or familiarity.
  • Intellectual Property experience and/or familiarity.
  • Prior experience with licensing issues is preferred but not required

Education Requirements

  • Must be a current student in an accredited law degree program.
  • Candidates must have taken a course in copyright law or equivalent and be well-versed in the principles of fair use. .

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a for-credit or stipend-eligible temporary externship.

Compensation

Course Credit: This externship is designed to be a learning experience for law students for which school credit must be obtained. Applicants must be able to comply with their school’s requirements for academic credit.

School-sponsored Stipends: During the summer, this externship may alternately be compensated through a program in which the student receives a stipend from their school for non-profit work.

Please include the following to be considered:

  • your resume
  • your cover letter
    • Please make sure you thoroughly explain your interest in and experience with copyright law.
    • All applicants must have taken copyright law before the externship begins, and your cover letter must say when and where you took the course.
